Alex / Evelyn — quick technical notes from our infra side before Wed: 

- Session format: recommend a 15m setup window followed by 75m hands-on. We need ~20m at the end to capture telemetry and confirm rollback points.
- Model selection: for the hands-on we'll demo two serving variants (rwf-7b-quant for low-cost tier; rwf-34b-fp16 for high-quality tier). If Nimbus wants to exercise regional routing we should confirm preferred regions (us-west, eu-central).
- Fallback rules: propose simple tiered fallback: low-latency -> quant model; if quality metric below threshold -> fallback to fp16 variant; if both exceed latency SLO -> route to batch-processing queue. We'll prototype this in the lab.
- Load test: for a short staged run, plan for 5 concurrent clients @ 100 req/min with 512-token average — this should be safe and representative. If you want heavier traffic we can schedule a separate overnight test.

I'll attach the team recommendations PDF (redwood-model-recommendations.pdf) and a checklist for keys & IP allowlist.

— Dev
